label: Froslass / Marnie's Grimmsnarl ex

wincon.plan: Evolve into a self-powered Grimmsnarl, then combine Shadow Bullet with Froslass counters and Munkidori transfers for multi-KO turns.

key_cards.enables: Turn-two Grimmsnarl from a surviving Impidimp.
Finds one Marnie's Pokemon every turn.
After a KO, redraws the opponent to two cards.
Converts spread damage by forcing a chosen Benched target Active.
